records.stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacy reviews clozapine dispensing on October 26, 2026. The pharmacy wants to replace its safety review with the old registry’s approval number.

Which overall conclusion correctly addresses the current regulatory and safety obligations? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Apply the isotretinoin iPLEDGE dispensing window as the replacement clozapine rule.
Treat removal of the REMS as removal of the need for ANC monitoring and clinical safety review.
Dispense only after restoring the former REMS enrollment and authorization process.
Remove the former REMS access requirement, while retaining appropriate label-based monitoring and patient-specific review.

explanation.core_reasoning: 2025-06-13 REMS 제거는 과거 등록·authorization 장벽을 없앴지만 neutropenia 위험과 label-based ANC monitoring, 적법한 처방·DUR 의무는 남는다.

choice_analysis.A: 선택하지 않을 항목. 서로 다른 약물 프로그램의 dispensing window 를 clozapine 의 대체 규칙으로 가져오지 않는다.
choice_analysis.B: 선택하지 않을 항목. 행정 프로그램 제거와 약물 위험·label 기반 monitoring 은 별개이다.
choice_analysis.C: 선택하지 않을 항목. FDA 가 제거한 REMS 의 enrollment/authorization 를 현행 필수 조건으로 다시 만들지 않는다.
choice_analysis.D: 선택할 항목. 2025-06-13 REMS 제거는 과거 등록·authorization 장벽을 없앴지만 neutropenia 위험과 label-based ANC monitoring, 적법한 처방·DUR 의무는 남는다.

explanation.learning_boundary: 같은 모델의 9개 문항은 조건·기록 조합을 바꾸는 연습 변형이다. 독립된 9개 법규나 실제 기출로 세지 않으며, 세트에는 모델별 한 문항만 선택한다.

records.stem:
The pharmacy is using the non-vaccine medication-administration pathway in DCP 26-03-124. Personnel, patient, product, and prescription requirements are otherwise met. An administration-related reaction requires additional testing in the emergency department.

Which response accurately reflects the circular’s wording? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Use professional judgment and contact the prescriber as encouraged to clarify the intended administration setting.
Appropriately communicate the reaction to the prescriber within 24 hours as the circular recommends.
Immediately report the event to the prescriber; assess any separate Board reporting duties.
Follow the prescriber’s appropriate reassessment interval; quarterly is an example rather than a universal fixed deadline.

explanation.core_reasoning: DCP26-03-124 의지정 seriousoutcome 이면 prescriber 에게 immediatereport 한다. 별도 Board 보고가있으면병행한다.

choice_analysis.A: 선택하지 않을 항목. 권장 notation 누락자체가모든유효처방을자동무효화하는조항은아니다. 목적이불분명한경우권장되는연락을연결한다.
choice_analysis.B: 선택하지 않을 항목. 일반 adverseevent/reaction 의 24 시간문구는 should 이다. 지정 seriousoutcome 의 immediate 의무와구별한다.
choice_analysis.C: 선택할 항목. DCP26-03-124 의지정 seriousoutcome 이면 prescriber 에게 immediatereport 한다. 별도 Board 보고가있으면병행한다.
choice_analysis.D: 선택하지 않을 항목. Circular 는 appropriateinterval 을 prescriber 가정하며 quarterly 는예시이다. 모든약에 90 일고정의무를새로만들지않는다.

Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

An intern performs final patient-specific prescription verification because the supervising pharmacist is nearby.
A supervised nationally certified technician counsels a patient about a newly prescribed inhaler.
